independent_qa.notes: Independent actual visual review and byte-identical technical reproduction passed; short neck, big mature face, full cap/ear, blue-gray narrow collar. Residual ~2px eye whites and small cap texture remain candidate notes.

selection_reason: v2 shortens the neck, narrows collar and enlarges mature face without sacrificing whole cap/curls/ear. MAXCOVERAGE technical quantization preserves very small blue-gray collar accents that MEDIANCUT lost. No third imagegen call or local repaint.
residual_notes: Eye-white patches remain roughly two pixels and are not strict one-pixel slits, but dimmer than v1.
Curls retain a few small subordinate clusters; not a native pixel-authored asset.
Palette ceiling is technical and temporary, not proof of designed shared game palette.
